author: coordinator
intent: Restore native round-half-up Q16 scaling before the 16-bit block writer halves and masks each component. This corrects a translation omission, not the original algorithm.
evidence: Pinned 5CD571..5CD580 and repeated component sites use signed IMUL, SHL EDX16, SHR EAX16, ADC EAX,EDX, then SAR EAX1 and AND EAX7F. SHR carries original product bit15 into ADC.

Existing sub_5cd3b0 expresses the same round-highword idiom. The private media_scale_signed_component previously omitted the carry, changing packed-bank indices for fractional positive and negative products.

Host tests extract actual helper and writer definitions, check all signed-byte components over eight signed scales, and check four output blocks against independent floor-division rounding. Host doubles do not establish complete codec or runtime acceptance.
